tagline: Classical East Asian spirit courts — Favor, Seals, and the Mandate.

creatures.name: Minister of Ledgers
creatures.story: An immortal clerk of Heaven's bureaucracy. He does not shout or strike — he amends. When the Mandate frayed, he stayed at his desk, rewriting names so carefully that destiny itself began to blur.
creatures.usage: When you place a Seal, draw 1. Core of Bureau control decks: reward careful Seal play and keep your hand full.

creatures.name: Star-Warden Qiulan
creatures.story: Guardian of the night road between peaks. Her bow is strung with constellation thread; each arrow pins a spirit to the hour it tried to flee. Mortals say the stars are nails she drove into the sky.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor to pin a Spirit so it cannot change lanes. Tempo control — freeze threats while your Seals stack.

creatures.name: The Debt Fox
creatures.story: Nine tails, each a ledger. She collects unpaid favors for Heaven with a soft smile. Those who bargain lightly wake to find their names already stamped in vermillion.
creatures.usage: Enter: look at rival's hand; they owe you 1 Favor next turn. Mythic disruptor — information plus resource theft.

creatures.name: Jade Drum General
creatures.story: A war drum of jade and bronze that learned to walk when Heaven needed an army. Every strike is a roll call; every echo a marching order.
creatures.usage: When this deals damage, you may place a Bureau Seal on a Site you control. Beatdown that advances the Mandate race.

creatures.name: Junior Auditor
creatures.story: Newest brush in the Bureau. His stamp is too large for his hands, but Heaven promotes those who finish the paperwork before dawn.
creatures.usage: Enter: gain 1 Favor. Early curve — accelerate into Ministers and Mythics.

creatures.name: Lady of a Thousand Masks
creatures.story: Hostess of the Night Market. She does not steal faces — she rents them, and the interest is identity. The empty hook on her wall is always waiting for yours.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: discard a card to copy another Spirit's Might until end of turn. Flexible combat trick engine.

creatures.name: River-Boy Kappa
creatures.story: Polite to a fault. He bows before he drowns you. The water crown on his head is both manners and weapon — spill it and his courtesy turns sharp.
creatures.usage: If undamaged, +2 Might; if damaged, rival gains 1 Favor. Glass cannon — protect him or accept the trade.

creatures.name: Lantern Bride
creatures.story: A wedding lantern that learned to walk. She seeks a true name; until then her flame-face softens every court that refuses her invitation.
creatures.usage: Enter: name a Court. Rival Spirits of that Court get -1 Might while she remains. Hate-bear against one faction.

creatures.name: Oni of Broken Gates
creatures.story: When sacred gates should stay shut, he is the one who opens them — with a club. Seals slide off his skin; thresholds do not.
creatures.usage: Can't hold Seals. Enter: open a Site from your deck. Aggressive Site tutor and high Might threat.

creatures.name: Alley Pickpocket
creatures.story: Small enough to vanish under hanging charms. Takes Charms from sleeves and secrets from pockets, then sells both back as rumors.
creatures.usage: Enter: rival discards a Charm if able; else you draw 1. Cheap disruption on the Alleys curve.

creatures.name: Tiger of the Pass
creatures.story: Guardian of the high road. Every traveler pays a tax — a riddle, a scar, or a Favor. Snow remembers his prints longer than names.
creatures.usage: Rival Spirits entering your lane must pay 1 Favor or enter exhausted. Gatekeeper for Kin midrange.

creatures.name: Granny of the Wind
creatures.story: She keeps storms braided in her hair. When the Mandate softens, she unties one strand and whole valleys forget which way is down.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor to exhaust a Spirit or Site. Soft lock and tempo denial.

creatures.name: Dokkaebi of the Brass Club
creatures.story: Laughing spirit of brass and bad bargains. Pebbles become gold; gold becomes trouble. He considers both outcomes a good night.
creatures.usage: Enter: create a Gold Pebble token Relic (spend it: gain 2 Favor, then exile it). Burst ramp into bigger Kin plays.

creatures.name: Silent Crane
creatures.story: Messenger between the three courts. Never speaks — only folds truth into paper and flies where seals still hold. Charms glance off white feathers.
creatures.usage: Can't be targeted by Charms. Once per game: look at top 5; take a Charm or Edict. Mythic tutor and protection.

creatures.name: Shrine Attendant
creatures.story: Keeps the mountain steps clear of snow and doubt. The bells know his footsteps; the tiger allows his broom.
creatures.usage: While you control a Kin Site, +2 Might. Rewards opening Pass of Old Grudges or Mountain Shrine early.

creatures.name: Pearl Abacus Spirit
creatures.story: A clerk-spirit made of pearl beads and counting rods. Every Favor spent near it is tallied twice — once for you, once for Heaven.
creatures.usage: Enter: gain 1 Favor if you control a Bureau Site. Cheap curve piece that rewards Gatehouse opens.

creatures.name: Moon Ink Brush
creatures.story: A living brush that paints destiny in silver moonlight. What it writes overnight becomes law by dawn — if the seal still sticks.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor → put a Bureau Seal on target Spirit you control. Seal enabler.

creatures.name: Tribunal Mirror
creatures.story: The Bureau’s judgment glass. It does not lie; it only shows the debt you hoped nobody saw.
creatures.usage: Enter: look at rival hand. Once per turn: if you have 2+ Seals, deal 1 to a Spirit. Info + chip damage.

creatures.name: Courier of Red Seals
creatures.story: Runs the cloud stairs with a satchel of glowing vermillion scrolls. Late deliveries rewrite entire courts.
creatures.usage: Enter: draw 1, then discard 1. Filter for Bureau control.

creatures.name: Empress of Empty Thrones
creatures.story: She sits the only occupied seat among vanishing thrones. When the Mandate expires, her silence is the new law.
creatures.usage: Enter: place a Seal of each Court you already have at least one of onto Sites you control (max one each). Mythic Seal payoff.

creatures.name: Paper-Cut Assassin
creatures.story: Folded from festival paper into a killer. Edges sharp enough to cut a name from a ledger.
creatures.usage: May attack as if it had +1 Might if you discarded a card this turn. Trick-reward aggro.

creatures.name: Sake Barrel Oni
creatures.story: Burst from a festival barrel laughing. Spilled sake becomes courage, then trouble.
creatures.usage: Enter: you and rival each draw 1. Chaotic card flow.

creatures.name: Twin Gate Cats
creatures.story: Sacred beckoning cats that guard alley thresholds — one white for luck, one black for bargains.
creatures.usage: While this is in play, the first Charm you cast each turn costs 1 less Favor (min 0). Charm engine.

creatures.name: Umbrella Ghost
creatures.story: A forgotten paper umbrella that hopped into life. Rain is its invitation; puddles are its doors.
creatures.usage: When a Site opens, this gets +2 Might until end of turn. Site-synergy spike.

creatures.name: Festival Drum Yokai
creatures.story: A taiko given hunger and fists. Each beat summons lanterns — and debts.
creatures.usage: When this deals damage, you may discard a card: if you do, deal 1 to another rival Spirit. Splash damage.

creatures.name: Stone Turtle of the Ridge
creatures.story: A ridge that learned to walk. A shrine rides its shell; centuries ride its patience.
creatures.usage: Can’t be exhausted by rival effects. Sturdy midrange anchor.

creatures.name: Firefly Monk
creatures.story: Lights the mountain path with borrowed stars. Guides the lost — and marks them for the Tiger’s tax.
creatures.usage: Enter: search your deck for a Kin Site, reveal it, shuffle, put it on top. Site tutor.

creatures.name: Avalanche Maiden
creatures.story: Soft voice, white robes, whole valleys sliding when she sighs.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 2 Favor → deal 2 to each exhausted rival Spirit. Punish stalls.

creatures.name: Iron Bell Warden
creatures.story: Shrine guardian fused to the bronze bell. When it rings, storms and trespassers both stop.
creatures.usage: Rival Charms targeting your Spirits cost 1 more Favor. Tax protection.

creatures.name: Mountain King Sansin
creatures.story: Lord of ridge and tiger. The Pass answers to him; even Heaven’s ledgers leave a blank line for his seal.
creatures.usage: Enter: exhaust all rival Spirits in your lane. Mythic board wipe soft-lock for Kin.

creatures.name: Inkstone Guardian
creatures.story: A living inkstone that remembers every name dipped into it. Spill its ink and a destiny blots out.
creatures.usage: Enter: if you control a Bureau Site, place a Bureau Seal on it.

creatures.name: Cloud Stair Porter
creatures.story: Hauls sealed chests up stairs of cloud. Late deliveries rewrite Heaven's schedule.
creatures.usage: Enter: put the top card of your deck into your hand if it is a Relic or Site; otherwise put it on the bottom.

creatures.name: Vermillion Quill
creatures.story: A feather that writes in blood-red law. What it crosses out never returns the same.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor → discard a card, then draw 1.

creatures.name: Night Archive Moth
creatures.story: Feeds on forgotten ledgers. Dust from its wings is powdered history.
creatures.usage: When a Seal is placed, gain 1 Favor once per turn.

creatures.name: Jade Seal Lion
creatures.story: Jade guardian with Heaven's stamp on its brow. Thieves become footnotes.
creatures.usage: Rival Spirits attacking your Sites get −1 Might.

creatures.name: Astral Census Clerk
creatures.story: Counts stars as citizens. When a star falls, someone is late on taxes.
creatures.usage: Enter: look at top 3 of your deck; put one into hand, rest on bottom in any order.

creatures.name: Phoenix of Rewritten Names
creatures.story: Burns names to ash and writes them again in gold. Resurrection is just better paperwork.
creatures.usage: Once per game: return a Spirit from your discard to play exhausted; place a Bureau Seal on it.

creatures.name: Bronze Gong Sentinel
creatures.story: Shield and alarm as one. When the gong rings, even foxes stand still.
creatures.usage: When this enters, exhaust target Spirit with Might 3 or less.

creatures.name: Silk Rope Binders
creatures.story: Twin cords that bind favors into seals. Soft silk, hard terms.
creatures.usage: Enter: pin a Spirit until end of turn (it can't change lanes).

creatures.name: Oracle of Half-Truths
creatures.story: Holds two cracked bones — one true, one kind. Courts pay for both.
creatures.usage: Enter: rival chooses — you draw 2, or they discard 2.

creatures.name: Shadow Puppet Twin
creatures.story: Two shadows, one will. Cut one and the other laughs.
creatures.usage: When this dies, create a 1-Might Shadow token Spirit.

creatures.name: Candy Apple Spirit
creatures.story: Festival sweetness with a bite. Sticky debts stick longest.
creatures.usage: Enter: rival gains 1 Favor; you draw 1.

creatures.name: Nekomata of Lost Keys
creatures.story: Two tails, endless keys. Opens doors that should stay locked — for a fee.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: discard a Charm → draw a Charm.

creatures.name: Wall Spirit Nurikabe
creatures.story: A smiling wall that blocks the path until you forget why you walked.
creatures.usage: Can't attack. Rival Spirits entering this lane enter exhausted.

creatures.name: Blade of Folded Fortune
creatures.story: Paper folded into a fortune, then into a sword. Luck cuts both ways.
creatures.usage: When you discard a card, this gets +1 Might until end of turn.

creatures.name: Tengu of Rooftop Markets
creatures.story: Watches deals from the tiles. Long nose, longer ledger of insults.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor → look at rival hand.

creatures.name: Mask Merchant Elder
creatures.story: Sells faces by lantern light. The price is always who you used to be.
creatures.usage: Enter: exchange the Court of one of your Spirits with another's permanently.

creatures.name: Will-o-Lantern Swarm
creatures.story: Tiny lantern faces in a spiral. Follow them and you arrive somewhere wrong.
creatures.usage: Deal 1 to each rival Spirit in a lane of your choice.

creatures.name: Bone Flute Piper
creatures.story: Plays foxfire into alleys. The tune makes debts dance.
creatures.usage: Enter: exhaust target Site.

creatures.name: Night Parade General
creatures.story: Leads the hundred demons' night march. Where he walks, lanterns bow.
creatures.usage: Enter: your other Alleys Spirits get +1 Might this turn. Draw 1.

creatures.name: Moss Deer of the Pass
creatures.story: Antlers hung with shrine bells. Soft steps, old taxes.
creatures.usage: While you control a Kin Site, this has +1 Might.

creatures.name: Pine Needle Archer
creatures.story: Shoots needles that whistle like wind through pines.
creatures.usage: Enter: deal 1 to target Spirit.

creatures.name: Landslide Boar
creatures.story: A hillside that learned tusks. Paths rearrange when it runs.
creatures.usage: When this attacks, you may close (exhaust) a Site.

creatures.name: Frost Bell Fox
creatures.story: White fox of ridge bells. Ring once for warning, twice for winter.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: spend 1 Favor → exhaust a Spirit with Might 2 or less.

creatures.name: Ridge Witch of Echoes
creatures.story: Calls across cliffs until echoes become birds that remember you.
creatures.usage: Once per turn: copy the enter effect of another Kin Spirit you control (pay costs).

creatures.name: Thunder Toad of the Valley
creatures.story: Storms ride its back. Valleys flood when it blinks.
creatures.usage: When you cast a Charm, deal 1 to a rival Spirit.

creatures.name: White Snake Immortal
creatures.story: Immortal in pale silk, serpent at her shoulder. Kindness with fangs.
creatures.usage: At end of your turn, if undamaged, heal 1 damage from another Spirit you control (or gain 1 Favor if none damaged).

creatures.name: Cliff Swallow Scout
creatures.story: Messenger of the ridges. Scrolls under wing, wind under feet.
creatures.usage: Enter: scry 2 (look top 2; reorder or bottom any).

creatures.name: Geomancy Compass Spirit
creatures.story: A luopan that spins until the land agrees. Wrong orientation invites grudges.
creatures.usage: Enter: search deck for a Site, reveal, shuffle, put on top.

creatures.name: Immortal of the Nine Peaks
creatures.story: Sits above nine summits. Even Heaven's Mandate looks up.
creatures.usage: Enter: gain Favor equal to Kin Sites you control (max 3). Your Kin Spirits get +1 Might this turn.

environments.name: Bureau Gatehouse
environments.story: Rain-polished stone and a vermillion lintel. Cross after the third lantern and you owe the Bureau a name.
environments.usage: Bureau Site. Opens +1 Favor. When opened, place a Bureau Seal here. Foundation of Seal strategies.

environments.name: Heaven's Ledger Hall
environments.story: Endless desks under cold starlight. Floating ink revises lives while clerks pretend not to listen.
environments.usage: Home stadium of the Bureau. Flavor arena for Favor and Seal contests — where Ministers feel strongest.

environments.name: Cloud Bridge of Stars
environments.story: A bridge of constellation thread between peaks. Qiulan walks it alone; others fall through the gaps between stars.
environments.usage: Sky stadium. Favors pin effects and ranged Spirits. Ideal showcase lane for Star-Warden Qiulan.

environments.name: Night Market of Masks
environments.story: Covered alley of hanging faces. Buy a mask, sell a memory, leave before your reflection puts one on.
environments.usage: Alleys Site. +1 Favor. Once per turn: discard 1 → draw 1. Filter engine for trick decks.

environments.name: River Court Shallows
environments.story: Reed water that looks polite. The Kappa holds court here; courtesy is the first trap.
environments.usage: Water stadium. Strengthens undamaged Kappa and Charm trades. Slippery midrange battlefield.

environments.name: Broken Torii Path
environments.story: Sacred gates in pieces. Embers still remember when they were holy. The Oni calls this a welcome mat.
environments.usage: Ruin stadium. Site-breaking and high Might thrive. Home turf for Oni of Broken Gates.

environments.name: Pass of Old Grudges
environments.story: Narrow snow road where every footprint is an unpaid debt. The Tiger taxes the living; the wind taxes the rest.
environments.usage: Kin Site. +1 Favor. Spirits here get +1 Might while damaged. Rewards resilient Kin boards.

environments.name: Mountain Shrine of Bells
environments.story: Bronze bells hung in frost. When they ring, storms listen. The Attendant sweeps; the Crane delivers; the Granny decides.
environments.usage: Sacred Kin stadium. Synergizes with Shrine Attendant and weather control. Quiet power midrange home.

environments.name: Vermillion Archive Vault
environments.story: Floating scrolls and stamped chests under starlight. Secrets filed under lock and constellation.
environments.usage: Bureau stadium. Seal strategies feel at home; draw/filter effects echo louder in flavor and demos.

environments.name: Hundred Yokai Night Road
environments.story: The parade road where lanterns outnumber stars. Walk it once and you join the count.
environments.usage: Alleys stadium. Aggro and discard tricks thrive; Night Parade General's home turf.

support.name: Constellation Thread
support.story: Silver thread stitching night to a sleeve.
support.usage: When Constellation Thread resolves, target Spirit you control gets +1 Might until end of turn. If it's Celestial Bureau, draw a card.

support.name: Rewrite the Line
support.story: The brush decides which fate survives the page.
support.usage: Move one Seal from any permanent to another legal permanent.

support.name: Borrowed Face
support.usage: Exchange the Court of two target Spirits you control until end of turn.

support.name: Hungry Courtesy
support.usage: Hungry Courtesy deals 2 damage to target Spirit. If you control a Kappa or Fox Spirit, draw a card.

support.name: Riddle Tax
support.usage: An opponent chooses: they give you 1 Favor, or the next Spirit they play enters exhausted.

support.name: Untie the Storm
support.usage: Untie the Storm deals 1 damage to each Spirit an opponent controls. Mountain Kin Spirits you control get +1 Might until end of turn.

support.name: Heaven's Receipt
support.usage: Equip / Attach to Spirit you control. Whenever attached Spirit survives damage, gain 1 Favor.

support.name: Broken Torii Shard
support.story: Sacred wood that remembers being a gate.
support.usage: Attach to Spirit you control. Attached Spirit may deal combat damage to Sites as though they were Spirits. (Damage can close a Site.)

support.name: Seal of the Three Courts
support.usage: At the beginning of your end step, if you control at least one Seal of each Court (Bureau, Alleys, Kin), you claim 1 Mandate progress.

support.name: The Expiring Mandate
support.story: The golden thread snaps — and the treaty rewrites itself.
support.usage: Cast only if you control 2 or more Seals. An opponent loses 1 Mandate progress. Draw two cards. Exile The Expiring Mandate.
